newsitem.title: USA: Diagnostic Health to buy diagnostic unit.
newsitem.headline: Diagnostic Health to buy diagnostic unit.

text.p: Diagnostic Health Services Inc said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy a unit of Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp for $13 million in cash and $4.5 million in preferred stock.
The transaction, involving Horizon's Advanced Clinical Technology Inc, is expected to close during the first two weeks of November.
Diagnostic Chairman and Chief Executive Max Batzer said in a statement he expected Advanced Clinical would have an "extremely" positive effect on the company's earnings.
Batzer did not elaborate on when it was expected the earnings boost would take place as a result of the acquisition.
Advanced Clinical provides ultrasound diagnostics and related services.
Diagnostic provides medical outsourcing services to hospitals, physicians' offices and other healthcare facilities.
